annotations.text: §4.2 said "one Q-PAIR call judges one pair", and the M4 gate showed what that costs: 159 calls for 159 pairs, $2.35 on 28 blocks, and ≈ $55–70 extrapolated to this repository (I-75).
A headless call carries ≈ 22k tokens of harness prompt whatever it asks, so the call count *is* the cost.
With D13's cap, the same corpus needs 15 calls instead of 159.
Rejected: a larger batch — Q-DESC settled on 8 (rel01 S21) because a longer call risks the timeout, and a timeout costs the whole batch.
